note: Written before the analysis was run on this app. `truth` is what a person reading the code can establish; `expected` is what a sound static analysis should report given its stated limits. A status that reassures (Imported-only, Present-only) where the truth is Reachable or Unknown is an unsafe reassurance; a Reachable where the truth isn't is a false Reachable.

rows.evidence: The advisory names HeaderUtils::split() and says HeaderBag calls it for Cache-Control whenever a Request is built; the fix commits (343a1772, 9ffa802e) change only that function outside tests. Path: public/index.php -> HttpFoundationFactory::createRequest (symfony/psr-http-message-bridge) -> new Request -> Request::__construct -> Request::initialize -> new HeaderBag -> HeaderBag::__construct -> HeaderBag::set -> HeaderBag::parseCacheControl -> HeaderUtils::split. The app reaches http-foundation only through the bridge.

public/import.php calls $parser->$action() with the method name taken from the request. With the default it reaches Parser::parse() and lexInlineStructure(), but which method runs is a runtime value, so a static analysis must not claim either Reachable or a reassuring status. symfony/yaml also declares the executable bin/yaml-lint, which is an uncertainty, not evidence it runs.
Required by composer.json and never used by the app. league/flysystem-local requires it back (and it requires flysystem-local), but nothing the app uses mentions either package.
